items.title: Increasing Investments in Early Warning Systems to Strengthen Climate and Disaster Resilience
items.role: Economic and Financial Analysis Specialist (International), Intermittent
items.location: Regional — Bangladesh, Cambodia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyz Republic, Lao PDR, Maldives, Mongolia, Nepal, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan
items.summary: Economic and financial analysis for a regional ADB technical assistance on early-warning systems, with ten countries in scope. Costing toolkits and cost-benefit models developed; economic and financial chapters and financing structures in preparation.
activities: Build costing toolkits and CBA models; support budget notes and procurement plans.
Design an M&E logframe aligned to Sendai and SDG 13; plan integration with national systems.

scope.label: countries in the technical assistance’s scope
